name: GBP/USD spot FX
notes: Spot FX from the free provider has no real volume. Swap/financing not modelled. Capital assumed in the quote currency. Broker terms unverified. gap_stress_pct = 1.25 x the worst overnight gap 7.6% in the cleaned usable history (floor per asset class, capped at 25 % because unadjusted contract rolls inflate the historical maximum); min_stop_pct = 25 % of the median daily range 0.64%.
